4030-4659-5224-6294.description:
Cast Marketback Walker by paying {1} due to Starnheim Courser, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Marketback Walker.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Marketback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Marketback Walker dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Marketback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

856-5776-6351-8249.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Teval trigger.
Resolve the Teval trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

985-4068-5078-8171.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
985-4068-5078-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

5254-5686-6774.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
5254-5686-6774.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token
Repeat.

225-2511-2577-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
225-2511-2577-7084.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the land.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6495-6972-7509.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Gleeful Arsonist
When Gleeful Arsonist dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Gleeful Arsonist
When Gleeful Arsonist dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Repeat.
6495-6972-7509.notes: If Gleeful Arsonist starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-5078-7902.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {1}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Fateful Discovery triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Fateful Discovery trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Repeat

116-1636-2681-7870.description:
Activate Forbidden Orchard by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Forbidden Orchard triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token under an opponent's control.
When the Spirit enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, untapping Forbidden Orchard.
Activate Hawkeye by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to the Spirit token. This'll destroy it due to it having 0 toughness.
Hawkeye triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-4264-5241.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-4264-5241.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Altered Ego and Sakashima's Student each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Altered Ego trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Sakashima's Student trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-4264-5241.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1619-3967-4605-5542-6138.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-3967-4605-5542-6138.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Bloodboil Sorcerer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Bloodboil Sorcerer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Bloodboil Sorcerer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Bloodboil Sorcerer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Bloodboil Sorcerer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Bloodboil Sorcerer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Bloodboil Sorcerer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Bloodboil Sorcerer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-3967-4605-5542-6138.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

4476-5641-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4476-5641-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

206-2457-3000-4289.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

3457-4460-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Seeker of Skybreak.
Activate one of the Seeker of Skybreak tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Seeker of Skybreak token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

546-1409-4613-7234.easyPrerequisites: There are a total of at least five cards in all hands.
546-1409-4613-7234.description:
Activate Realm Seekers by paying {1}{U}, blinking it. Realm Seekers enters with at least five +1/+1 counters due to its replacement effect.
When Realm Seekers enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Realm Seekers.
Activate Realm Seekers using Ramos's ability by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

628-6797-7218.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Reaping Willow.
When Reaping Willow dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat.

1409-4716-6441.description:
Activate Prosperous Innkeeper by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Prosperous Innkeeper enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Prosperous Innkeeper.
Resolve the Prosperous Innkeeper trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

2893-3470-4136-6763.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When the basic land enters, Lotus Cobra and Roaring Earth trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Roaring Earth trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1453-2387-3490-6968.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
1453-2387-3490-6968.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token that enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to Arwen's toughness.
Animation Module triggers. Holding priority, activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token that enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to Arwen's toughness.
Repeat from step 3.

1127-3152-4188.notablePrerequisites: You have gained at least 4 life this turn.
1127-3152-4188.description:
Activate Accomplished Alchemist by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}.
Cast Blinking Spirit by paying {3}{W}.
Chakram Retriever triggers, untapping Accomplished Alchemist.
Activate Blinking Spirit by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

803-5853-6797.manaNeeded: {3}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
803-5853-6797.description:
Cast Wick either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Wick enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, if you control a Snail, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the Snail, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train.
If needed, repeat step 3 until you do not control a Snail.
Resolve the Wick trigger, creating a 1/1 Snail creature token.
When the Snail enters the battlefield as a Rat due to Arcane Adaptation, Wick triggers.
Repeat from step 3.

527-542-6633.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using only colored mana.
Selvala can tap to produce at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast the other creature card.
527-542-6633.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast a creature card from your hand.
Cast a creature card by paying its mana cost.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning the creature cast in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1339-2122-3384-5231.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw two cards.
The Locust God triggers twice, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens with flying and haste.
Activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing two Insects, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Mindless Automaton's first ability twice by paying {2} and discarding two cards, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

225-4693-5531-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least two lands between the battlefield and your graveyard.
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {G}.
225-4693-5531-5702.description:
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 3 until you control no lands.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Lumra.
Put the token Lumra into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger that many times.
Resolve a Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Repeat from step 9 for each remaining Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve all but one Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating that many 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

222-527-997-4359.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-997-4359.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Woe Strider twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

527-1350-4404.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 6 or greater.
Selvala does not have summoning sickness.
527-1350-4404.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {3}{G}{W}{U}.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {1}{U}.
When Corridor Monitor enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Selvala.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Corridor Monitor to your hand.
Repeat.
If you control a creature with power 7 or greater, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may target another creature using Corridor Monitor's ability.

3951-4711.notablePrerequisites:
Éomer cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
You have at least three opponents.
3951-4711.description:
Declare Éomer as an attacker.
Éomer's myriad ability triggers, creating at least two token copies of it tapped and attacking each other opponent.
Put all Éomer tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Éomer token(s) die, each Éomer token triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1174-1257-1846-2725.notablePrerequisites:
Tideforce Elemental and Walking Atlas do not have summoning sickness.
You control at least two Islands that enters the battlefield untapped.
1174-1257-1846-2725.description:
Cast High Tide by paying {U}.
Activate two Islands by tapping them, adding {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning a tapped Island to your hand, untapping another Island.
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting an Island from your hand onto the battlefield.
Whenever the Island enters the battlefield, Tideforce Elemental triggers.
Holding priority, activate Tideforce Elemental by paying {U} and tapping it, untap Walking Atlas.
Resolve the Tideforce Elemental trigger, untapping itself.
Repeat from step 2.

2605-3525-4348.notablePrerequisites:
Ley Druid does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Ley Druid.
2605-3525-4348.description:
Activate Lotus Vale by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Ley Druid by tapping it, untapping Lotus Vale.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Ley Druid.
Repeat any number of times.
Repeat steps with a different color for infinite mana of any color.

3249-4050-4242.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi, adding one mana of any color.
Su-Chi triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, targeting Su-Chi.
Cast Su-Chi from graveyard by paying {4}.
Repeat.

813-3617-4305.notablePrerequisites: Followed Footsteps attached to Scholar of the Ages.
813-3617-4305.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying {1}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Followed Footsteps triggers, creating a copy of Scholar of the Ages.
Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, returning Time Walk to your hand.
Repeat.
